seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Tavares, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Tavares, Florida for 2026: the Christmas parade and festival, Cookies with Santa and a Spanish Christmas story time.
lede: Tavares, known as America's Seaplane City, celebrates with a downtown parade and festival, cookies with Santa and a Spanish story time.
celebrates: Tavares keeps its Christmas close to downtown and its lakefront. The Christmas Parade and Celebration fills Historic Downtown Tavares on Saturday, December 5, according to the city calendar, with a festival at Wooton Park and Tavares Square after the parade. Cookies with Santa follows on Thursday, December 17, at the Public Works Operation Center, and the Tavares Public Library holds a Spanish Story Time Christmas Edition on Friday, December 18. The parade and Cookies with Santa are free, and the library calendar prints no price for its story time.
lastyear: Last year Tavares held its Christmas parade and celebration on Saturday, December 6, 2025, with the parade at 5 pm and Santa arriving by seaplane at 7 pm, according to Inside Lake. The festival that followed in Wooton Park and Tavares Square included holiday entertainers, snow, Santa's visit and food vendors. For 2026 the city calendar lists the Christmas Parade and Celebration on Saturday, December 5.
facts: Tavares calls itself America's Seaplane City, and Santa's arrival by seaplane at the Wooton Park celebration was part of the 2025 Christmas tradition, according to Inside Lake. Wooton Park hosts the festival after the parade, and the Tavares Public Library is at 314 North New Hampshire Avenue. The city calendar lists Cookies with Santa at the Public Works Operation Center on Captain Haynes Road.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Tavares itself, and we only list rides we can verify on a host page. Our Florida Christmas train rides guide collects the closest holiday train rides across the state for a longer day out. Eustis, a short drive away, has a trackless train for kids at Festive Friday in Ferran on December 11, according to the city's event page.
